sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Easter eggs and References:
  - This item is a parody of the gun lubricant "FIREClean" and also a reference to the content creator and former Battlestate Games community manager Klean. It likely originated from Klean making the joke "Fire Klean" around the time the Escape from Tarkov community questioned his suitability for the community manager role.
  - The packaging is based on the "Slip 2000 Gun Lube".
  - The phrase "Can also be used in some other cases!" from the description refers to a "FIREClean" controversy in which it was discovered that its chemical composition is very similar to common vegetable oil.
